# ggs

Source: [GGS](https://github.com/kirjner/GGS).

Role: data.

GFP/AAV data and pretrained CNN fitness oracles. Use scripts/download_gfp_aav_sources.py for checksum-checked source downloads. Exact approved task splits and initial labels are supplied in the companion artifact bundle.

Pinned commit: `033c543c44aa76655e4868bb71e5713c962401ea`. To inspect this exact version inside this folder:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/kirjner/GGS.git external/ggs/source
git -C external/ggs/source checkout --detach 033c543c44aa76655e4868bb71e5713c962401ea
```

The source checkout is optional and ignored by Git. See the upstream LICENSE and notices at the pinned revision before redistributing source. This folder documents provenance; it does not replace upstream attribution.
